input: Find family-owned German machine-tool manufacturers (Mittelstand) with 100-500 employees

output.search_notes: Screen completed as_of 2026-11-04: 13 matches supported by opened public sources. Machine tools include metal-cutting, grinding and metal-forming machines; generic industrial-equipment manufacturers were excluded. Rankings prioritize direct thesis fit and evidence quality, not investment returns. Employee figures are estimates for the named business, with geographic scope stated; larger parent-group totals were not substituted. An undated page accessed on 2026-11-04 is not treated as a dated 2026 headcount. Missing_fields are listed within criteria_evidence because the requested schema has no separate missing_fields property. Null last_round means no verifiable disclosed funding round was found, not that the company has never received financing. Important exclusions: vhf has a DBAG minority investment, confirmed by company news and DBAG's current portfolio (https://www.vhf.com/en/press/deutsche-beteiligungs-ag-acquires-stake-in-vhf-group/; https://www.dbag.de/portfolio/portfoliounternehmen/vhf). ARKU ceased to qualify following its announced acquisition by listed GESCO on 2026-10-01; GESCO's portfolio records 100% ownership (https://www.arku.com/en-us/news/arku-becomes-part-of-gesco-se; https://gesco.de/en/portfolio/arku-maschinenbau-gmbh). This is the verified set found, not a claim of exhaustive coverage of the German market.
